messages:
nate: Quick FYI: sampleapp onboarding guide references `client.generate()` but the REST endpoint is `/v1/generate` with slightly different param names: REST uses `max_tokens` while SDK uses `maxTokens`. Confusing for copy/paste.
sara: oof. We normalized to camelCase in SDK but docs had a mix. New users paste from REST example into SDK examples and get silent ignored params because SDK drops unknown keys.
nate: can we make SDK log a warning when unknown top-level generation params are passed? That'd help catch drifting docs.
sara: yes, but careful about log noise for prod libs. Maybe only warn in non-production environments or when client.config.verbose=true.
bot-deploy: docs update PR merged to staging docs/generate-examples (build 2026-03-23_02:12)
sara: I'll sweep quickstart and update code blocks to match SDK casing. Then add a note in REST->SDK migration guide.
nate: ok assigning myself to a lint rule to detect camelCase/underscore mismatches in docs repo.
sara: cool, thanks.
